heroHeadline: Day 726: Sheinbaum Closes 32-State Accountability Tour at the Zócalo, Warns Against Foreign 'Injerencia'
heroSubtitle: September 27, 2026 marks Day 726 of Claudia Sheinbaum's presidency. She closed her nationwide "Honestidad y Resultados" accountability tour — which covered all 32 states since September 1 and drew an estimated 850,000 total attendees — with a Zócalo message on the 205th anniversary of the Consumación de la Independencia, declaring "soberanía quiere decir que solo el pueblo determina el destino de México" and warning against foreign intervention amid ongoing US-Mexico security talks. The day before, September 26 (Day 725), she presented her Second Government Report in Hermosillo, Sonora, announcing Port of Guaymas modernization and the restitution of 45,794 hectares to the Yaqui people. On September 25 (Day 724), Attorney General Ernestina Godoy fired the FGR's Guanajuato delegate over anomalies in the record fuel-seizure investigation, and Sheinbaum said from Villahermosa, Tabasco that the Juchitán mayor's extortion arrest was unrelated to the attack on designer Elvis Guerra — contradicting Oaxaca Governor Salomón Jara — while declining to meet Andy López Beltrán amid his revoked US visa. On September 24 (Day 723), she hosted South Korean President Lee Jae-myung's first state visit to Mexico in 16 years, signing 17 cooperation agreements, as LEGO announced a $400 million Nuevo León investment.
